findings.label: .opts breakpoint asymmetry (900px vs 820px)
findings.detail: The viewport path uses min-width:900px for two-column .opts while the demo path keeps the pre-existing min-width:820px, so in the 820-899px band a demo user sees two columns and a non-demo user sees one. Intentional and documented in a CSS comment and the plan; demo behavior is unchanged. No action required unless a single consolidated 900px breakpoint is preferred.
